_why: F38#1 (5.35), F38#2 (5.58), F38#26 (5.77): all three code-blind judges said Meadows creatures 'sit in the shaded tree-trunk band, read as small dark blobs, no rim light'. When enabled, scripts/world/creature_rim.gd gives every creature body (wild and companion) spawned while a listed realm look is loaded a subtle cool fresnel backlight edge, reusing scripts/world/stormwood_character_rim.gd's overlay()/dress() and shaders/character_rim_overlay.gdshader (material overlay, additive, unshaded, no shadows). Cool pale, never red/oxblood. Combat tell auras, boss auras and hit/level-up glows take the overlay slot over the rim and hand it back when they end. Client presentation only; no state, no collision. OFF until GPU judged.
_why_held: Held OFF in batch 6 (#814, 4 Nov 2026): the judged ON arm (qj rim10, energy 1.0 / power 1.8, F38#1 CPU 5.53 -> 5.84) makes net and region smokes log ERROR: Parameter "material" is null (material_get_instance_shader_parameters) on the dummy renderer; with the rim OFF the same smokes are clean. It ships ON again with the visual lane's fix.
